470 inline energy_t gcd(energy_t a, energy_t b) {
471  a = abs(a);
472  b = abs(b);
473  if (a == 0) return b;
474  if (b == 0) return a;
475  while (b != 0) {
476  energy_t r = a % b;
477  a = b;
478  b = r;
479  }
480  return a;
481 }

507 template <typename T>
508 class Vector {
509  std::vector<T> data_;
510 
511  template <typename U, typename Op>
512  Vector<T> &vector_operation(const Vector<U> &rhs, Op operation) {
513  if (size() != rhs.size()) {
514  throw std::out_of_range(
515  THROW_MESSAGE("Vector size mismatch: ", size(), " != ", rhs.size()));
516  }
517  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), size(), [&](size_t i) {
518  operation((*this)[i], rhs[i]);
519  (*this)[i] = static_cast<T>((*this)[i]);
520  });
521  return *this;
522  }
523 
524  template <typename U, typename Op>
525  Vector<T> &vector_operation(Vector<U> &&rhs, Op operation) {
526  if (size() != rhs.size()) {
527  throw std::out_of_range(
528  THROW_MESSAGE("Vector size mismatch: ", size(), " != ", rhs.size()));
529  }
530  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), size(), [&](size_t i) {
531  operation((*this)[i], std::move(rhs[i]));
532  (*this)[i] = static_cast<T>((*this)[i]);
533  });
534 
535  return *this;
536  }
537 
538  template <typename Op>
539  Vector<T> &vector_operation(const Expr &rhs, Op operation) {
540  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), size(),
541  [&](size_t i) { operation((*this)[i], rhs); });
542  return *this;
543  }
544

546  Vector() = default;

564  template <typename U, typename = typename std::enable_if<

568  template <typename U>

799 class VarArray2 {

828

830

833

836  const Var *begin() const { return vars_; }
837  const Var *end() const { return vars_ + size(); }

839  void clear() {

859 
860  void pop_back() {

864  vars_[0] = VarVoid;
865  }
866  }

870  }

877  VarArray2 &operator*=(const VarArray2 &vars) {
878  if (vars_[0] == VarVoid) {

882  vars_[1] = vars.vars_[0];

886  }
887  } else if (vars.vars_[0] != VarVoid) {
888  throw std::out_of_range(

890  }
891  return *this;
892  }

1238  terms_.resize(old_size + terms.size());
1239  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), terms.size(),

1409  Expr &operator*=(const Term &term) {

1411  for (auto &t : terms_) {
1412  t *= term;
1413  }
1414  } else {
1415  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), terms_.size(),
1416  [&](size_t i) { terms_[i] *= term; });
1417  }
1418  if (constant_ != 0) {
1419  *this += term * static_cast<coeff_t>(constant_);
1420  constant_ = 0;
1421  }
1422  return *this;
1423  }

1457  Expr &operator*=(const Expr &expr) {
1458  if (expr.term_count() == 0) {
1459  return *this *= expr.constant_;
1460  }
1461 
1462  if (expr.term_count() == 1) {
1463  terms_ =
1464  terms_ * expr.terms_[0] + terms_ * expr.constant_ +
1465  expr.terms_ * constant_;
1466  constant_ *= expr.constant_;
1467  return *this;
1468  }
1469 
1470  Expr result{constant_ * expr.constant_};
1471  result += terms_ * expr.terms_;
1472  result += terms_ * static_cast<coeff_t>(expr.constant_);
1473  result += expr.terms_ * static_cast<coeff_t>(constant_);
1474 
1475  *this = std::move(result);
1476  return *this;
1477  }

1651 
1652  VarInt(
1653  const std::tuple<Expr, std::string, energy_t, energy_t,
1654  std::shared_ptr<std::vector<coeff_t>>, Vector<Var>> &t)
1655  : Expr(std::get<0>(t)),
1656  var_str_(std::get<1>(t)),
1657  min_val_(std::get<2>(t)),
1658  max_val_(std::get<3>(t)),
1659  coeffs_ptr_(std::get<4>(t)),
1660  vars_(std::get<5>(t)) {}
1661 
1662  std::tuple<Expr, std::string, energy_t, energy_t,
1663  std::shared_ptr<std::vector<coeff_t>>, Vector<Var>>
1664  helper_func(const std::string &var_str, energy_t min_val, energy_t max_val,
1665  std::shared_ptr<std::vector<coeff_t>> coeffs_ptr) const {
1666  Vector<Var> vars;
1667  if (coeffs_ptr->size() == 1) {
1668  vars.push_back(var(var_str));
1669  } else {
1670  for (size_t i = 0; i < coeffs_ptr->size(); i++) {
1671  vars.push_back(var(var_str + "[" + std::to_string(i) + "]"));
1672  }
1673  }
1674  Expr expr{min_val};
1675  for (size_t i = 0; i < coeffs_ptr->size(); i++) {
1676  expr += Term(vars[i], (*coeffs_ptr)[i]);
1677  }
1678 
1679  return std::make_tuple(expr, var_str, min_val, max_val, coeffs_ptr, vars);
1680  }
1681 
1682  public:
1683  VarInt(const std::string &var_str, energy_t min_val, energy_t max_val,
1684  std::shared_ptr<std::vector<coeff_t>> coeffs_ptr)
1685  : VarInt(helper_func(var_str, min_val, max_val, coeffs_ptr)) {}
1686 
1687  VarInt(const VarInt &) = default;
1688 
1689  std::string get_name() const { return var_str_; }
1690 
1691  vindex_t var_count() const { return static_cast<vindex_t>(vars_.size()); }
1692 
1693  energy_t min_val() const { return min_val_; }
1694 
1695  energy_t max_val() const { return max_val_; }
1696 
1697  coeff_t coeff(vindex_t i) const { return (*coeffs_ptr_)[i]; }
1698 
1699  Var get_var(vindex_t i) const { return vars_[i]; }
1700 
1701  Var operator[](vindex_t i) const { return vars_[i]; }
1702 
1703  VarValMap get_val_map(energy_t val) const {
1704  if (val < min_val_ || val > max_val_) {
1705  throw std::out_of_range(
1706  THROW_MESSAGE("Value (", str(val), " out of range."));
1707  }
1708  val -= min_val_;
1709  VarValMap result;
1710  for (size_t i = var_count(); i >= 1; i--) {
1711  if (val >= (*coeffs_ptr_)[static_cast<size_t>(i) - 1]) {
1712  result[vars_[i - 1]] = 1;
1713  val -= (*coeffs_ptr_)[i - 1];
1714  } else {
1715  result[vars_[i - 1]] = 0;
1716  }
1717  }
1718  return result;
1719  }
1720 };

1733 class VarOnehot {
1734  const std::string var_str_;
1735

1737  const energy_t max_val_;
1738 
1739  const Vector<Var> vars_;
1740 
1741  const Expr expr_;
1742 
1743  const Vector<Var> new_vars() const {
1744  if (min_val_ > max_val_) {
1745  throw std::runtime_error(
1746  THROW_MESSAGE("min_val must be less than or equal to max_val."));
1747  }
1748  Vector<Var> vars;
1749  if (min_val_ == max_val_) {
1750  vars.push_back(var(var_str_));
1751  } else {
1752  for (energy_t i = 0; i <= max_val_ - min_val_; i++) {
1753  vars.push_back(var(var_str_ + "[" + str(i) + "]"));
1754  }
1755  }
1756  return vars;
1757  }
1758 
1759  const Expr new_expr() const {
1760  Expr result = Expr{0};
1761  for (energy_t i = 0; i <= max_val_ - min_val_; i++) {
1762  result += Term(vars_[static_cast<size_t>(i)],
1763  static_cast<coeff_t>(i + min_val_));
1764  }
1765  return result;
1766  }

1768  public:
1769  VarOnehot(const std::string &var_str, energy_t min_val, energy_t max_val)
1770  : var_str_(var_str),
1771  min_val_(min_val),
1772  max_val_(max_val),
1773  vars_(new_vars()),
1774  expr_(new_expr()) {}

1778  Expr operator*() const;
1779 
1780  template <typename T,
1781  typename std::enable_if<std::is_integral<T>::value, int>::type = 0>
1782  Expr select(const std::vector<T> &values) const {
1783  if (values.empty()) {
1784  throw std::runtime_error(THROW_MESSAGE("values is empty."));
1785  }
1786  Expr result;
1787  for (const auto &val : values) {
1788  if (val < min_val_ || val > max_val_) {
1789  throw std::out_of_range(
1790  THROW_MESSAGE("Value (", str(val), " out of range."));
1791  }
1792  result += Term(vars_[static_cast<size_t>(val - min_val_)]);
1793  }
1794  return result;
1795  }
1796 
1797  template <typename T,
1798  typename std::enable_if<std::is_integral<T>::value, int>::type = 0>
1799  Expr select(std::initializer_list<T> values) const {
1800  return select(std::vector<T>(values));
1801  }

2011 class BitVector {
2012  const vindex_t bit_count_;
2013 
2014  const vindex_t size64_;
2015 
2016  std::unique_ptr<uint64_t[]> bits_;
2017 
2018  public:
2019  explicit BitVector(vindex_t bit_count)
2020  : bit_count_(bit_count),
2021  size64_((bit_count + 63) / 64),
2022  bits_(std::make_unique<uint64_t[]>(size64_)) {}
2023 
2024  explicit BitVector(const BitVector &bit_vector)
2025  : bit_count_(bit_vector.bit_count_),
2026  size64_(bit_vector.size64_),
2027  bits_(std::make_unique<uint64_t[]>(size64_)) {
2028  std::copy(bit_vector.bits_.get(), bit_vector.bits_.get() + size64_,
2029  bits_.get());
2030  }
2031 
2032  BitVector(BitVector &&bit_vector)
2033  : bit_count_(bit_vector.bit_count_),
2034  size64_(bit_vector.size64_),
2035  bits_(std::move(bit_vector.bits_)) {};
2036 
2037  BitVector &operator=(const BitVector &bit_vector) {
2038  if (this == &bit_vector) {
2039  return *this;
2040  }
2041  if (size64_ != bit_vector.size64_) {
2042  throw std::runtime_error(
2043  THROW_MESSAGE("BitVector: Different size of bit vector."));
2044  }
2045  std::copy(bit_vector.bits_.get(), bit_vector.bits_.get() + size64_,
2046  bits_.get());
2047  return *this;
2048  }

2055  if (this == &bit_vector) {
2056  return *this;
2057  }
2058  if (size64_ != bit_vector.size64_) {
2059  throw std::runtime_error(
2060  THROW_MESSAGE("BitVector: Different size of bit vector."));
2061  }
2062  bits_ = std::move(bit_vector.bits_);

2066  BitVector &operator=(BitVector &&bit_vector) {
2067  if (this == &bit_vector) {
2068  return *this;
2069  }
2070  if (bit_count_ != bit_vector.bit_count_) {
2071  throw std::runtime_error(

2073  }

2078  bool operator==(const BitVector &bit_vector) const {
2079  if (bit_count_ != bit_vector.bit_count_) {
2080  throw std::runtime_error(
2081  THROW_MESSAGE("BitVector: Different size of bit vector."));
2082  }
2083  return std::equal(bits_.get(), bits_.get() + size64_,
2084  bit_vector.bits_.get());

2087  bool operator!=(const BitVector &bit_vector) const {

2089  }

2091  bool operator<(const BitVector &bit_vector) const {
2092  auto reverse_bits = [](uint64_t n) -> uint64_t {
2093 #if defined(__has_builtin)
2094 #if __has_builtin(__builtin_bitreverse64)
2095  return __builtin_bitreverse64(n);
2096 #endif
2097 #endif
2098  n = ((n >> 1) & 0x5555555555555555) | ((n & 0x5555555555555555) << 1);
2099  n = ((n >> 2) & 0x3333333333333333) | ((n & 0x3333333333333333) << 2);
2100  n = ((n >> 4) & 0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f) | ((n & 0x0f0f0f0f0f0f0f0f) << 4);
2101  n = ((n >> 8) & 0x00ff00ff00ff00ff) | ((n & 0x00ff00ff00ff00ff) << 8);
2102  n = ((n >> 16) & 0x0000ffff0000ffff) | ((n & 0x0000ffff0000ffff) << 16);
2103  n = ((n >> 32) & 0x00000000ffffffff) | ((n & 0x00000000ffffffff) << 32);
2104  return n;
2105  };
2106  for (vindex_t i = 0; i < size64_; i++) {
2107  if (reverse_bits(bits_[i]) < reverse_bits(bit_vector.bits_[i]))
2108  return true;
2109  if (reverse_bits(bits_[i]) > reverse_bits(bit_vector.bits_[i]))
2110  return false;
2111  }
2112  return false;
2113  }

2115  vindex_t size() const { return bit_count_; }
2116 
2117  vindex_t size64() const { return size64_; }
2118 
2119  const uint64_t *get_bits_ptr() const { return bits_.get(); }
2120 
2121  bool get(vindex_t index) const {
2122  if (index >= bit_count_) {
2123  throw std::out_of_range(THROW_MESSAGE("Index out of range."));
2124  }
2125  return bits_[index / 64] & (1ULL << (index % 64));
2126  }
2127 
2128  void set(vindex_t index, bool value) {
2129  if (index >= bit_count_) {
2130  throw std::out_of_range(THROW_MESSAGE("Index out of range."));
2131  }
2132  if (value)
2133  bits_[index / 64] |= 1ULL << (index % 64);
2134  else
2135  bits_[index / 64] &= ~(1ULL << (index % 64));
2136  }
2137 
2138  void flip(vindex_t index) {
2139  if (index >= bit_count_) {
2140  throw std::out_of_range(THROW_MESSAGE("Index out of range."));
2141  }
2142  bits_[index / 64] ^= 1ULL << (index % 64);
2143  }
2144 
2145  uint64_t get64(vindex_t index64) const {
2146  if (index64 >= size64_) {
2147  throw std::out_of_range(THROW_MESSAGE("Index out of range."));
2148  }
2149  return bits_[index64];
2150  }
2151 
2152  uint64_t set64(vindex_t index64, uint64_t value) {
2153  if (index64 >= size64_) {
2154  throw std::out_of_range(THROW_MESSAGE("Index out of range."));
2155  }
2156  if (index64 < size64_ - 1 || index64 * 64 == bit_count_)
2157  return bits_[index64] = value;
2158  else
2159  return bits_[index64] = value & ((1ULL << (bit_count_ % 64)) - 1);
2160  }
2161 
2162  void clear() { std::fill(bits_.get(), bits_.get() + size64_, 0); }
2163 
2164  vindex_t popcount() const {
2165  vindex_t count = 0;
2166  for (vindex_t i = 0; i < size64_; i++) {
2167  count += static_cast<vindex_t>(__builtin_popcountll(bits_[i]));
2168  }
2169  return count;
2170  }
2171 
2172  std::string str() const {
2173  std::string result;
2174  for (vindex_t i = 0; i < bit_count_; i++) {
2175  result += get(i) ? "1" : "0";
2176  }
2177  return result;
2178  }
2179 };
2180 }

2369  return std::nullopt;

2371  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mtx_);
2372  if (new_sol.energy() < sol_.energy()) {

2374  sol_ = new_sol;

2378  return std::nullopt;

2384  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mtx_);

2386  return sol_;

2388  return std::nullopt;
2389  }
2390  }

2574 inline std::string str(const QuadModel &quad_model) {

2579  for (vindex_t i = 0; i < quad_model.var_count(); i++) {

2581  qbpp::str(quad_model.linear(i));
2582  for (vindex_t j = 0; j < quad_model.degree(i); j++) {

2585  result += " +";
2586  else if (coeff == -1)
2587  result += " -";
2588  else if (coeff > 1)
2589  result += " +" + qbpp::str(coeff) + "*";
2590  else
2591  result += " " + qbpp::str(coeff) + "*";
2592  result += str_impl(quad_model.var(index), str) + "/2";
2593  }
2594  result += ")";
2595  }
2596  return result;
2597 }

2618  oss << str(arg);

2620  oss << "," << str_val << "}";
2621  },
2622  key);
2623  }
2624 
2625  oss << "}";
2626  return oss.str();

2711 inline std::string str_short(const Expr &expr) {
2712  if (expr.term_count() <= 5) return str(expr);
2713  std::string result;
2714  if (expr.constant() != 0) result += qbpp::str(expr.constant()) + " + ";
2715  auto it = expr.terms().begin();
2716  result += str(*it) + " + ";
2717  ++it;
2718  result += str(*it) + " + ... + ";
2719  it = expr.terms().end();
2720  --it;
2721  --it;
2722  result += str(*it) + " + ";
2723  ++it;
2724  result += str(*it);
2725  result += " (" + qbpp::str(expr.term_count()) + " terms)";
2726  return result;

2736 inline size_t vars_hash::operator()(const Vars &vars) const {

2739  for (const auto &item : vars) {
2740  seed ^= hasher(item.index()) + 0x9e3779b9 + (seed << 6) + (seed >> 2);
2741  }
2742  return seed;
2743 }

2768 inline VarValMap list_to_var_val(const MapList &map_list) {
2769  VarValMap var_int_map;
2770  for (const auto &[key, val] : map_list) {
2771  if (val.term_count() >= 1) {
2772  throw std::runtime_error(THROW_MESSAGE("Value must be an integer."));
2773  }
2774  auto constant = val.constant();
2775  std::visit(
2776  [&](auto &&arg) {
2777  using T = std::decay_t<decltype(arg)>;
2778  if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, VarInt>) {
2779  for (const auto &[var, bin_val] :
2780  arg.get_val_map(static_cast<coeff_t>(constant))) {
2781  var_int_map[var] = bin_val;
2782  }
2783  } else {
2784  var_int_map[arg] = static_cast<var_val_t>(constant);
2785  }
2786  },
2787  key);
2788  }
2789  return var_int_map;
2790 }

2792 inline MapDict list_to_dict(const MapList &map_list) {

2794  for (const auto &[key, val] : map_list) {
2795  auto val_local = val;
2796  std::visit(
2797  [&](auto &&arg) {
2798  using T = std::decay_t<decltype(arg)>;
2799  if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, VarInt>) {
2800  if (val_local.term_count() >= 1) {
2801  throw std::runtime_error(
2802  THROW_MESSAGE("VarInt must have a constant."));
2803  }
2804  for (const auto &[var, bin_val] :
2805  arg.get_val_map(static_cast<coeff_t>(val_local.constant()))) {
2806  map_dict[var] = bin_val;
2807  }
2808  } else {
2809  map_dict[arg] = val_local;
2810  }
2811  },
2812  key);
2813  }
2814  return map_dict;
2815 }

2846  const VarValMap &var_val_map) {

2850  tbb::blocked_range<size_t>(0, expr.terms().size()),
2851  static_cast<energy_t>(0),
2852  [&](const tbb::blocked_range<size_t> &range, energy_t local_result) {
2853  for (size_t i = range.begin(); i < range.end(); ++i) {
2854  local_result += eval(expr.terms()[i], var_val_map);

2856  return local_result;

2858  [](energy_t lhs, energy_t rhs) { return lhs + rhs; });

3002 inline std::vector<coeff_t> comp_coeffs(energy_t min_val, energy_t max_val,
3003  energy_t base_coeff = 1) {
3004  std::vector<coeff_t> coeffs;
3005  coeff_t val = static_cast<coeff_t>(max_val - min_val);
3006  if (val <= 0) {
3007  throw std::invalid_argument(THROW_MESSAGE(
3008  "max_val(", max_val, ") must be greater than min_val(", min_val, ")"));
3009  }
3010  coeff_t current_coeff = static_cast<coeff_t>(base_coeff);
3011  while (val > 0) {
3012  if (current_coeff < val) {
3013  coeffs.push_back(current_coeff);
3014  } else {
3015  coeffs.push_back(val);
3016  }
3017  val -= current_coeff;
3018  current_coeff *= 2;
3019  }
3020  return coeffs;
3021 }

3026  std::make_shared<std::vector<coeff_t>>(

3174 inline coeff_t gcd(const Expr &expr) {
3175  const auto &terms = expr.terms();
3176  energy_t result = tbb::parallel_reduce(
3177  tbb::blocked_range<size_t>(0, terms.size()),
3178  expr.constant(),
3179  [&](const tbb::blocked_range<size_t> &range, energy_t local_result) {
3180  for (size_t i = range.begin(); i < range.end(); ++i) {
3181  const auto &term = terms[i];
3182  local_result = gcd(local_result, term.coeff());
3183  }
3184  return local_result;
3185  },
3186  [](energy_t a, energy_t b) {
3187  return gcd(a, b);
3188  }
3189  );
3190  return static_cast<coeff_t>(abs(result));
3191 }

3199 inline ExprExpr comparison(const Expr &expr, energy_t minimum,
3200  energy_t maximum) {
3201  energy_t val = maximum - minimum;
3202  if (val < 0) {
3203  throw std::runtime_error(THROW_MESSAGE("RHS (", maximum,
3204  ") must be greater than LHS (",
3205  minimum, ") in operator <=."));
3206  } else if (val == 0) {
3207  return ExprExpr((expr - minimum) == 0, expr);
3208  } else if (val == 1) {
3209  return ExprExpr((expr - minimum) * (expr - maximum), expr);
3210  } else {
3211  VarInt slack_var = new_var_int(impl::VarSet::new_unnamed_var_str(), minimum,
3212  maximum - 1, 2);
3213  return ExprExpr((expr - slack_var) * (expr - (slack_var + 1)), expr);
3214  }
3215 }

3250 inline void sort_vars_in_place(Vars &vars) {
3251  if (vars.size() <= 1) {
3252  return;
3253  } else if (vars.size() == 2) {
3254  if (vars[0] > vars[1]) std::swap(vars[0], vars[1]);
3255  } else {
3256  std::sort(vars.begin(), vars.end());
3257  }
3258 }

3266 inline Vars sort_vars_as_binary(const Vars &vars) {
3267 #if MAXDEG == 2
3268  if (vars[0] != qbpp::impl::VarVoid) {
3269  if (vars[1] != qbpp::impl::VarVoid) {
3270  if (vars[0] < vars[1]) {
3271  return vars;
3272  } else if (vars[0] == vars[1]) {
3273  return Vars(vars[0]);
3274  } else {
3275  return Vars(vars[1], vars[0]);
3276  }
3277  }
3278  }
3279  return vars;
3280 #else
3281  auto result = vars;
3282  sort_vars_in_place(result);
3283  if (result.size() >= 2)
3284  result.erase(std::unique(result.begin(), result.end()), result.end());
3285  return result;
3286 #endif
3287 }

3289 inline Vars sort_vars_as_spin(const Vars &vars) {
3290 #if MAXDEG == 2
3291  if (vars[0] != qbpp::impl::VarVoid) {
3292  if (vars[1] != qbpp::impl::VarVoid) {
3293  if (vars[0] < vars[1]) {
3294  return vars;
3295  } else if (vars[0] == vars[1]) {
3296  return Vars(qbpp::impl::VarArray2::EMPTY{});
3297  } else {
3298  return Vars(vars[1], vars[0]);
3299  }
3300  }
3301  }
3302  return vars;
3303 #else
3304  auto result = vars;
3305  sort_vars_in_place(result);
3306  if (result.size() >= 2) {
3307  for (auto it = result.begin();
3308  it != result.end() && it + 1 != result.end();) {
3309  if (*it == *(it + 1)) {
3310  it = result.erase(it, it + 2);
3311  } else {
3312  ++it;
3313  }
3314  }
3315  }
3316  return result;
3317 #endif
3318 }

3321 inline Expr simplify_seq(const Expr &expr,
3322  Vars (*sort_vars_func)(const Vars &) = sort_vars) {
3323  VarsCoeffMap vars_val_map;
3324  Expr result = expr.constant();
3325  for (const auto &term : expr.terms()) {
3326  auto new_vars = (*sort_vars_func)(term.vars());
3327  if (new_vars.size() == 0) {
3328  result += term.coeff();
3329  } else {
3330  vars_val_map[new_vars] += term.coeff();
3331  }
3332  }
3333  for (const auto &[vars, val] : vars_val_map) {
3334  if (val != 0) {
3335  result += Term{vars, val};
3336  }
3337  }
3338  std::sort(result.terms().begin(), result.terms().end());
3339  return result;
3340 }
3341 
3342 inline Expr simplify(const Expr &expr,
3343  Vars (*sort_vars_func)(const Vars &) = sort_vars) {
3344  if (expr.size() < SEQ_THRESHOLD) return simplify_seq(expr, sort_vars_func);
3345 
3346  Terms simplified_terms;
3347  simplified_terms.resize(expr.terms().size());
3348 
3349  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), expr.terms().size(), [&](size_t i) {
3350  simplified_terms[i] =
3351  Term(sort_vars_func(expr.terms()[i].vars()), expr.terms()[i].coeff());
3352  });
3353 
3354  tbb::parallel_sort(simplified_terms.begin(), simplified_terms.end());
3355 
3356  const size_t size = simplified_terms.size();
3357  constexpr size_t min_chunk_size = 32;
3358  size_t max_chunk_count = std::thread::hardware_concurrency();
3359  size_t chunk_count =
3360  std::min((size + min_chunk_size - 1) / min_chunk_size, max_chunk_count);
3361  size_t chunk_size = (size + chunk_count - 1) / chunk_count;
3362 
3363  std::vector<Terms> chunk(chunk_count);
3364  std::vector<energy_t> constant(chunk_count, 0);
3365  std::vector<size_t> indices(chunk_count);
3366 
3367  tbb::parallel_for(
3368  tbb::blocked_range<size_t>(0, chunk_count),
3369  [&](const tbb::blocked_range<size_t> &range) {
3370  for (size_t i = range.begin(); i < range.end(); ++i) {
3371  size_t start = i * chunk_size;
3372  size_t end = std::min(start + chunk_size, size);
3373 
3374  for (size_t j = start; j < end; ++j) {
3375  if (simplified_terms[j].coeff() == 0) {
3376  continue;
3377  }
3378  if (simplified_terms[j].var_count() == 0) {
3379  constant[i] += simplified_terms[j].coeff();
3380  continue;
3381  }
3382  if (chunk[i].empty()) {
3383  chunk[i].push_back(std::move(simplified_terms[j]));
3384  continue;
3385  }
3386  if (chunk[i].back().vars() == simplified_terms[j].vars()) {
3387  chunk[i].back().coeff() += simplified_terms[j].coeff();
3388  if (chunk[i].back().coeff() == 0) {
3389  chunk[i].pop_back();
3390  }
3391  continue;
3392  }
3393  chunk[i].emplace_back(std::move(simplified_terms[j]));
3394  }
3395  }
3396  });
3397 
3398  for (size_t i = 1; i < chunk_count; ++i) {
3399  if (!chunk[i - 1].empty()) {
3400  if (chunk[i].empty()) {
3401  chunk[i].push_back(std::move(chunk[i - 1].back()));
3402  chunk[i - 1].pop_back();
3403  continue;
3404  }
3405  if (chunk[i - 1].back().vars() == chunk[i].front().vars()) {
3406  chunk[i].front().coeff() += chunk[i - 1].back().coeff();
3407  chunk[i - 1].pop_back();
3408  if (chunk[i].front().coeff() == 0) {
3409  chunk[i].erase(chunk[i].begin());
3410  }
3411  }
3412  }
3413  }
3414 
3415  std::vector<size_t> prefix(chunk_count + 1, 0);
3416  energy_t result_constant = expr.constant();
3417  for (size_t i = 0; i < chunk_count; ++i) {
3418  prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + chunk[i].size();
3419  result_constant += constant[i];
3420  }
3421 
3422  Terms result_terms;
3423  result_terms.resize(prefix.back());
3424  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), size_t(chunk_count), [&](size_t i) {
3425  std::copy(chunk[i].begin(), chunk[i].end(),
3426  result_terms.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(prefix[i]));
3427  });
3428 
3429  return Expr(result_constant, std::move(result_terms));
3430 }
3431 
3432 template <typename T>
3433 Vector<T> simplify(const Vector<T> &vec,
3434  Vars (*sort_vars_func)(const Vars &) = sort_vars) {
3435  Vector<T> result(vec.size());
3436  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), vec.size(), [&](size_t i) {
3437  result[i] = simplify(vec[i], sort_vars_func);
3438  });
3439  return result;
3440 }

3460 inline bool is_simplified(const Expr &expr) {
3461  for (auto it = expr.terms().begin(); it != expr.terms().end(); ++it) {
3462  if (it->coeff() == 0) {
3463  return false;
3464  }
3465  for (auto it_var = it->vars().begin(); it_var != it->vars().end();
3466  ++it_var) {
3467  if (it_var != it->vars().begin() && *it_var < *(std::prev(it_var))) {
3468  return false;
3469  }
3470  }
3471  if (it != expr.terms().begin() && *it < *(std::prev(it))) {
3472  return false;
3473  }
3474  }
3475  return true;
3476 }

3478 inline bool is_binary(const Expr &expr) {
3479  for (const auto &term : expr.terms()) {
3480  if (term.var_count() > 2) {
3481  return false;
3482  }
3483  if (term.var_count() == 2 && term.vars()[0] == term.vars()[1]) {
3484  return false;
3485  }
3486  }
3487  return true;
3488 }

3492 inline energy_t Sol::comp_energy() const {
3493  const auto &terms = quad_model_.expr().terms();
3494  energy_t constant = quad_model_.constant();
3495 
3496  energy_t term_sum = tbb::parallel_reduce(
3497  tbb::blocked_range<size_t>(0, terms.size()), static_cast<energy_t>(0),
3498  [&](const tbb::blocked_range<size_t> &range, energy_t acc) {
3499  for (size_t i = range.begin(); i < range.end(); ++i) {
3500  const auto &term = terms[i];
3501  energy_t term_energy = term.coeff();
3502  for (auto item : term.vars()) {
3503  if (get(item) == 0) {
3504  term_energy = 0;
3505  break;
3506  }
3507  }
3508  acc += term_energy;
3509  }
3510  return acc;
3511  },
3512  std::plus<energy_t>());
3513 
3514  return term_sum + constant;
3515 }

3526 inline Expr reduce_sum(const Term &term) {
3527  coeff_t num_var = static_cast<coeff_t>(term.var_count());
3528  if (num_var <= 2) {
3529  return Expr{term};
3530  }
3531  Expr sum_vars =
3532  std::accumulate(term.vars().begin(), term.vars().end(), Expr(0));
3533  if (term.coeff() < 0) {
3534  return term.coeff() * qbpp::var() * (sum_vars - (num_var - 1));
3535  }
3536  VarInt aux_var =
3537  new_var_int(impl::VarSet::new_unnamed_var_str(), 0, num_var - 2, 2);
3538  Expr result =
3539  term.coeff() * (sum_vars - aux_var) * (sum_vars - (aux_var + 1));
3540  return simplify_as_binary(result) / 2;
3541 }
3542 
3543 inline Expr reduce_cascade(const Term &term) {
3544  coeff_t var_count = static_cast<coeff_t>(term.var_count());
3545  if (var_count <= 2) {
3546  return Expr{term};
3547  }
3548  Term temp = term;
3549  auto aux_var = qbpp::var();
3550  auto tail1 = temp.vars().back();
3551  temp.vars().pop_back();
3552  auto tail0 = temp.vars().back();
3553  temp.vars().pop_back();
3554  temp.vars().push_back(aux_var);
3555  return reduce_cascade(temp) +
3556  abs(term.coeff()) *
3557  (tail0 * tail1 - 2 * (tail0 + tail1) * aux_var + 3 * aux_var);
3558 }
3559 
3560 
3561 inline Expr reduce(const Expr &expr) {
3562  Expr result = expr.constant();
3563  for (const auto &term : expr.terms()) {
3564  if (term.coeff() < 0 || term.var_count() <= 4) {
3565  result += reduce_sum(term);
3566  } else
3567  result += reduce_cascade(term);
3568  }
3569  return result;
3570 }

3575 inline Expr binary_to_spin(const Expr &expr) {
3576  Expr result = 4 * expr.constant();
3577  for (const auto &term : expr.terms()) {
3578  if (term.var_count() == 0) {
3579  result += term.coeff();
3580  } else if (term.var_count() == 1) {
3581  result += 2 * term.coeff() * (term.vars()[0] + 1);
3582  } else if (term.var_count() == 2) {
3583  result += term.coeff() * (term.vars()[0] + 1) * (term.vars()[1] + 1);
3584  } else {
3585  throw std::runtime_error(
3586  THROW_MESSAGE("The term must be linear or quadratic, but degree is ",
3587  term.var_count(), "."));
3588  }
3589  }
3590  return result.simplify_as_spin();
3591 }
3592 
3593 inline Expr spin_to_binary(const Expr &expr) {
3594  Expr result = expr.constant();
3595  for (const auto &term : expr.terms()) {
3596  const auto &vars = term.vars();
3597  Expr spin_expr = 1;
3598  for (const auto &v : vars) {
3599  spin_expr *= (2 * v - 1);
3600  }
3601  result += term.coeff() * spin_expr;
3602  }
3603  return result.simplify_as_binary();
3604 }

3901 Expr sum(const Vector<Expr> &expr) {
3902  Expr result;
3903  size_t n = expr.size();
3904  std::vector<size_t> indices(n + 1, 0);
3905 
3906  for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
3907  indices[i + 1] = indices[i] + expr[i].term_count();
3908  result.constant() += expr[i].constant();
3909  }
3910 
3911  size_t total_terms = indices.back();
3912  result.terms().resize(total_terms);
3913 
3914  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), n, [&](size_t i) {
3915  auto &dst = result.terms();
3916  auto &src = expr[i].terms();
3917  std::copy(src.begin(), src.end(),
3918  dst.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(indices[i]));
3919  });
3920 
3921  return result;
3922 }

3924 template <typename T>
3925 Expr sum(const Vector<T> &items) {
3926  std::vector<Expr> result;
3927  result.reserve(items.size());
3928  for (const auto &item : items) {
3929  result.push_back(toExpr(item));
3930  }
3931  std::vector<size_t> indices(result.size() + 1);
3932  energy_t constant = 0;
3933  for (size_t i = 0; i < result.size(); ++i) {
3934  indices[i + 1] = indices[i] + result[i].term_count();
3935  constant += result[i].constant();
3936  }
3937  Terms terms;
3938  terms.resize(indices.back());
3939  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), result.size(), [&](size_t i) {
3940  std::copy(result[i].terms().begin(), result[i].terms().end(),
3941  terms.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(indices[i]));
3942  });
3943  return Expr(constant, std::move(terms));
3944 }

4159 template <typename T>
4160 Expr diff(const Vector<T> &items, energy_t head = 0, energy_t tail = 0) {
4161  if (items.empty()) {
4162  return 0;
4163  }
4164  Expr result = sqr(head - items[0]);
4165  for (size_t i = 0; i < items.size() - 1; ++i) {
4166  result += sqr(items[i] - items[i + 1]);
4167  }
4168  result += sqr(items[items.size() - 1] - tail);
4169  return result;
4170 }

4174  energy_t tail = 0) {

4176  Vector<SubResultType> result(items.size());
4177  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), items.size(),
4178  [&](size_t i) { result[i] = diff(items[i], head, tail); });
4179  return result;
4180 }

4401  return -1;
4402  }

4441 inline std::vector<Var> impl::IndexVarMapper::compute_index_var(
4442  const Expr &expr) {
4443  std::vector<std::pair<int8_t, vindex_t>> var_set(all_var_count(), {1, 0});
4444  if (expr.term_count() == 0) return {};
4445 
4446  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), expr.terms().size(), [&](size_t i) {
4447  const auto &term = expr.terms()[i];
4448  for (const auto &var : term.vars()) {
4449  var_set[var.index()] = {0, var.index()};
4450  }
4451  });
4452 
4453  tbb::parallel_sort(var_set.begin(), var_set.end());
4454 
4455  vindex_t non_zero_count = all_var_count();
4456  for (vindex_t i = 1; i < all_var_count(); ++i) {
4457  if (var_set[i - 1].first == 0 && var_set[i].first == 1) {
4458  non_zero_count = i;
4459  break;
4460  }
4461  }
4462 
4463  std::vector<Var> index_var(non_zero_count, Var(vindex_limit));
4464  for (vindex_t i = 0; i < non_zero_count; ++i) {
4465  index_var[i] = Var(var_set[i].second);
4466  }
4467 
4468  return index_var;
4469 }

4474  if (expr1.term_count() == 0 && expr2.term_count() == 0) return {};
4475 
4476  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), expr1.terms().size(), [&](size_t i) {
4477  const auto &term = expr1.terms()[i];
4478  for (const auto &var : term.vars()) {
4479  var_set[var.index()] = {0, var.index()};
4480  }
4481  });
4482 
4483  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), expr2.terms().size(), [&](size_t i) {
4484  const auto &term = expr2.terms()[i];
4485  for (const auto &var : term.vars()) {
4486  var_set[var.index()] = {0, var.index()};
4487  }
4488  });
4489 
4490  tbb::parallel_sort(var_set.begin(), var_set.end());
4491 
4492  vindex_t non_zero_count = all_var_count();
4493  for (vindex_t i = 1; i < all_var_count(); ++i) {
4494  if (var_set[i - 1].first == 0 && var_set[i].first == 1) {
4495  non_zero_count = i;

4499

5157 inline std::tuple<bool, size_t, size_t, coeff_t, coeff_t>
5158 check_if_simplified_as_binary(const Expr &expr) {
5159  if (expr.term_count() == 0) {
5160  return {false, 0, 0, 0, 0};
5161  }
5162  const auto &terms = expr.terms();
5163  bool error = false;
5164  size_t linear_count = 0;
5165  coeff_t min_coeff = terms[0].coeff();
5166  coeff_t max_coeff = terms[0].coeff();
5167  std::mutex mtx;
5168 
5169  tbb::parallel_for(
5170  tbb::blocked_range<size_t>(0, terms.size()),
5171  [&](const tbb::blocked_range<size_t> &range) {
5172  coeff_t local_min = min_coeff;
5173  coeff_t local_max = max_coeff;
5174  for (size_t i = range.begin(); i < range.end(); ++i) {
5175  const auto &term = terms[i];
5176 
5177  if (local_min > term.coeff()) local_min = term.coeff();
5178  if (local_max < term.coeff()) local_max = term.coeff();
5179 
5180  if (term.var_count() == 0 || term.var_count() >= 3) {
5181  error = true;
5182  return;
5183  }
5184  if (term.var_count() == 2 && term.vars()[1] <= term.vars()[0]) {
5185  error = true;
5186  return;
5187  }
5188 
5189  if (i > 0) {
5190  if (term <= terms[i - 1]) {
5191  error = true;
5192  return;
5193  }
5194  if (terms[i - 1].var_count() == 1 && term.var_count() == 2) {
5195  linear_count = i;
5196  }
5197  }
5198  }
5199 
5200  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mtx);
5201  if (local_min < min_coeff) min_coeff = local_min;
5202  if (local_max > max_coeff) max_coeff = local_max;
5203  });
5204 
5205  if (terms.back().var_count() == 1) {
5206  linear_count = terms.size();
5207  }
5208  return {error, linear_count, terms.size() - linear_count, min_coeff,
5209  max_coeff};
5210 }

5212 inline QuadModel::Impl::Impl(const qbpp::Model &model)
5213  : linear_(model.var_count(), 0),
5214  degree_(model.var_count(), 0),
5215  quadratic_(model.var_count()) {
5216  const auto var_count = model.var_count();
5217  const Expr &expr = model.expr();
5218  const Terms &terms = expr.terms();
5219  auto [error, linear_count, quadratic_count, min_coeff, max_coeff] =
5220  check_if_simplified_as_binary(expr);
5221  if (error) {
5222  throw std::runtime_error(
5223  THROW_MESSAGE("The expression must be simplified as binary or spin."));
5224  }
5225  min_coeff_ = min_coeff;
5226  max_coeff_ = max_coeff;
5227 
5228  if (model.expr().terms().size() == 0) {
5229  return;
5230  }
5231 
5232  if (linear_count > 0) {
5233  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), linear_count, [&](size_t i) {
5234  linear_[model.index(terms[i].vars()[0])] = terms[i].coeff();
5235  });
5236  }
5237 
5238  if (quadratic_count == 0) {
5239  return;
5240  }
5241 
5242  std::vector<Term> quadratic(quadratic_count * 2);
5243  auto linear_count_local = linear_count;
5244 
5245 #if MAXDEG == 2
5246  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), quadratic_count, [&](size_t i) {
5247  auto &term0 = quadratic[2 * i];
5248  auto &term1 = quadratic[2 * i + 1];
5249  term0 = terms[i + linear_count_local];
5250  term1.coeff() = term0.coeff();
5251  term1.var(0) = term0.var(1);
5252  term1.var(1) = term0.var(0);
5253  });
5254 
5255 #else
5256  tbb::parallel_for(size_t(0), quadratic_count, [&](size_t i) {
5257  quadratic[2 * i] = terms[i + linear_count_local];
5258  quadratic[2 * i + 1].coeff() = terms[i + linear_count_local].coeff();
5259  quadratic[2 * i + 1].vars().push_back(
5260  terms[i + linear_count_local].vars()[1]);
5261  quadratic[2 * i + 1].vars().push_back(
5262  terms[i + linear_count_local].vars()[0]);
5263  });
5264 #endif
5265 
5266  tbb::parallel_sort(quadratic.begin(), quadratic.end());
5267 
5268  std::vector<size_t> quadratic_index(var_count + 1, quadratic_count * 2);
5269 
5270  for (size_t i = 0; i <= model.index(quadratic[0].vars()[0]); ++i) {
5271  quadratic_index[i] = 0;
5272  }
5273 
5274  tbb::parallel_for(
5275  tbb::blocked_range<size_t>(1, quadratic_count * 2),
5276  [&](const tbb::blocked_range<size_t> &range) {
5277  for (size_t i = range.begin(); i < range.end(); ++i) {
5278  if (quadratic[i - 1].vars()[0] != quadratic[i].vars()[0]) {
5279  size_t start = model.index(quadratic[i - 1].vars()[0]) + 1;
5280  size_t end = model.index(quadratic[i].vars()[0]) + 1;
5281 
5282  for (size_t j = start; j < end; ++j) {
5283  quadratic_index[j] = i;
5284  }
5285  }
5286  }
5287  });
5288 
5289  quadratic_index[model.index(quadratic[quadratic_count * 2 - 1].vars()[0]) +
5290  1] = quadratic_count * 2;
5291 
5292  tbb::parallel_for(static_cast<vindex_t>(0), var_count, [&](size_t i) {
5293  degree_[i] =
5294  static_cast<vindex_t>(quadratic_index[i + 1] - quadratic_index[i]);
5295  });
5296 
5297  tbb::parallel_for(
5298  tbb::blocked_range<size_t>(0, var_count),
5299  [&](const tbb::blocked_range<size_t> &range) {
5300  for (size_t i = range.begin(); i < range.end(); ++i) {
5301  quadratic_[i].reserve(degree_[i]);
5302  for (size_t j = quadratic_index[i]; j < quadratic_index[i + 1]; ++j) {
5303  quadratic_[i].push_back(
5304  {model.index(quadratic[j].vars()[1]), quadratic[j].coeff()});
5305  }
5306  }
5307  });
5308 }
